title: The asymmetry
statement: An improvement -- a shorter sequence, a better circuit, a valid colouring -- is checked in milliseconds by replaying the object. An optimality claim is checked, in most of the literature, by nobody: the certificate is petabytes or does not exist. Three independent literature sweeps converged on this without being asked.

formal.statement: positive witness: O(|object|) replay. negative: refutation proof over the whole search space.
